_comment: Plain-English notes per table/column for the SQL Analyst's schema_lookup tool. Sensitive columns are flagged with "sensitive": true.

customers.description: One row per customer record. A customer_id exists per order; the real person is customer_unique_id.

customer_id.meaning: Key used to join orders to customers. Different for every order, even for the same person.

customer_unique_id.meaning: Identifier of the real person across orders. Count distinct values to count buyers.

customer_zip_code_prefix.meaning: First 5 digits of the customer's postal code. Approximate home area.

customer_state.meaning: Two-letter Brazilian state code, e.g. SP, RJ, MG.

geolocation.description: Latitude/longitude samples for Brazilian zip code prefixes. Many rows per prefix (about one million rows), so aggregate before joining.

geolocation_zip_code_prefix.meaning: First 5 digits of a postal code. Joins to customer or seller zip prefixes.

geolocation_city.meaning: City name for the sample point.

orders.description: One row per order with its status and lifecycle timestamps. Central table of the database.

order_id.meaning: Unique order identifier. Joins to order_items, order_payments and order_reviews.

order_status.meaning: One of created, approved, invoiced, processing, shipped, delivered, unavailable, canceled.

order_purchase_timestamp.meaning: When the customer placed the order. Use this to assign orders to months.

order_approved_at.meaning: When payment was approved. NULL if never approved.

order_delivered_carrier_date.meaning: When the seller handed the parcel to the carrier. NULL if not shipped.

order_delivered_customer_date.meaning: When the customer received the parcel. NULL if not delivered.

order_estimated_delivery_date.meaning: Delivery date promised to the customer at checkout.

order_items.description: One row per product line in an order. An order with 3 items has 3 rows. Source of item revenue and freight.

order_item_id.meaning: Sequence number of the item within the order, starting at 1.

seller_id.meaning: Joins to sellers.seller_id. The seller who fulfils this item.

shipping_limit_date.meaning: Deadline for the seller to hand the item to the carrier.

price.meaning: Item price in BRL, excluding freight.

freight_value.meaning: Freight charge in BRL for this item.

order_payments.description: One row per payment used on an order. An order can have several rows (split payments, vouchers).

payment_sequential.meaning: Sequence number of the payment within the order.

payment_type.meaning: credit_card, boleto, voucher, debit_card or not_defined.

payment_installments.meaning: Number of instalments chosen by the customer.

payment_value.meaning: Amount paid in BRL for this payment row.

order_reviews.description: Customer satisfaction reviews. review_id is not unique in the source data, and an order can have more than one review.

review_score.meaning: Integer rating 1 (very poor) to 5 (excellent). 1-2 negative, 4-5 positive.

review_comment_title.meaning: Optional title in Portuguese. Often NULL.

review_comment_message.meaning: Optional free-text comment in Portuguese. Often NULL; may contain personal details.

review_creation_date.meaning: When the satisfaction survey was sent.

review_answer_timestamp.meaning: When the customer answered the survey.

products.description: One row per product with its category and physical attributes.

product_category_name.meaning: Category in Portuguese. Join product_category_translation for English. Can be NULL.

product_name_lenght.meaning: Number of characters in the product name. Original column name keeps the typo 'lenght'.

product_description_lenght.meaning: Number of characters in the description. Original typo 'lenght' kept.

sellers.description: One row per seller (a business that sells on the marketplace).

seller_zip_code_prefix.meaning: First 5 digits of the seller's postal code.

product_category_translation.description: Lookup table from Portuguese category names to English.

product_category_name.meaning: Category name in Portuguese. Joins to products.product_category_name.

product_category_name_english.meaning: Category name in English, e.g. health_beauty, computers_accessories.
